summary: Stellantis N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release on Q2 2026 estimated consolidated shipments. The release discloses operational metrics: shipments of approximately 1.6 million units, up 10% year-over-year, with regional breakdowns including North America (+38%) and Enlarged Europe (+5%). There are no deal terms, no M&A activity, no activist campaign, no restructuring, and no financial restructuring. The filing is a routine business update on vehicle sales volumes and does not constitute a special situation under typical event-driven classifications. The registrant is simply the issuer reporting ordinary operational results.
